_comment: Standard benchmark platform. Every algorithm runs on exactly this robot, sensors, timing and error model. Do not edit per algorithm; changing it invalidates comparisons with earlier runs.
name: bStem stereo robot (standard benchmark platform)

stereo._comment: Positions are in the robot body frame (x forward, y left, z up; origin at the wheel axle centre, 0.043 m above the floor). Cameras look along +x. The bStem MT9M114 stereo mode is 640x720 per camera; the benchmark renders the 2x-downsampled 320x360 image (same field of view).

imu._comment: bStem L3GD20 3-axis gyro and LSM303DLHC accelerometer, at the body origin. BstemSensors.read() gives the yaw rate; BstemSensors.imu() gives all three body rates (same error model per axis) and the raw accelerometer.

radio._comment: Stands in for bStem WiFi broadcast. Applied by sensors/bstem_sensors.py to every algorithm: packets beyond the per-robot bandwidth limit are dropped.

sensor_errors._comment: Hardware-like errors injected by the standard sensor interface; unknown to the algorithms. Each robot's random stream is seed + 100 * robot number, so runs are repeatable. Benchmark noise scenarios multiply the noise terms.
